summary: 44-year-old man with a piece of steak stuck for 6 hours, unable to swallow saliva, drooling. ESGE: complete oesophageal obstruction → emergency endoscopy, preferably within 6 h; no barium swallow.

inputs.hpi: Piece of steak stuck in the lower chest at dinner six hours ago. Cannot swallow anything, not even his own saliva — spitting into a bowl and drooling. Retching without bringing it up. Two previous episodes that passed on their own. Breathing comfortably.

exam.general: Distressed, spitting saliva. Speaking in full sentences, no stridor. No surgical emphysema.

confirmedDiagnosis.name: Oesophageal food bolus obstruction
confirmedDiagnosis.assessmentText: Complete oesophageal food bolus obstruction (unable to swallow saliva) — emergency OGD for bolus removal; biopsies for underlying eosinophilic oesophagitis or stricture.

emergencyLevel.note: Cannot handle saliva: aspiration risk; the app's own APCQ grades "cannot swallow saliva" as emergency.

mustInclude.knownGapNote: Web 2026-09-25: passed before pane model 1.0.0 only because the wrong PANE top 3 (GORD: "OGD") seeded that protocol's tests; PANE now ranks oesophageal food bolus obstruction, which has no management protocol yet, so nothing seeds an emergency OGD.
mustInclude.proposedFix: A protocol for the PANE node food_bolus with emergency OGD within 6 hours for complete obstruction (ESGE 2016 foreign bodies).

mustExclude.note: ESGE recommends against barium swallow in suspected food bolus (aspiration, impairs endoscopy).

guideline.name: ESGE Clinical Guideline — removal of foreign bodies in the upper gastrointestinal tract in adults
guideline.section: Complete oesophageal obstruction (unable to manage saliva): emergent endoscopy, preferably within 6 h (at the latest within 24 h); push or retrieval technique; biopsies to find the underlying cause; barium swallow not recommended
guideline.citation: Birk M, Bauerfeind P, Deprez PH, et al. Endoscopy. 2016;48:489–496.

guideline.name: WSES guidelines — esophageal emergencies (perforation, caustic ingestion, foreign bodies)
guideline.section: Food bolus impaction with complete obstruction requires emergency flexible endoscopy
guideline.citation: Chirica M, Kelly MD, Siboni S, et al. World J Emerg Surg. 2019;14:26.

guideline.name: BSG/BSPGHAN joint consensus guidelines — diagnosis and management of eosinophilic oesophagitis in children and adults
guideline.section: Food bolus obstruction in young adults: biopsy for eosinophilic oesophagitis
guideline.citation: Dhar A, Haboubi HN, Attwood SE, et al. Gut. 2022;71:1459–1487.

rationale: Base food-bolus case with complete obstruction. The distinguishing feature from ordinary dysphagia is inability to swallow saliva, which moves the case from a 2-week OGD to an emergency endoscopy.

authoring.author: Claude (upper-GI cluster)
